description: This file implements the creation, initialization, and removal functions for a cryptographic public key object in a modular crypto library. It defines functions like AnscCryptoPubCreate, AnscCryptoPubRemove, and AnscCryptoPubInitialize, which manage the lifecycle and setup of the ANSC_CRYPTO_PUB_OBJECT, including assigning function pointers for cryptographic operations.

classes.name: ANSC_CRYPTO_PUB_OBJECT
classes.description: A struct representing a cryptographic public key object containing function pointers for its operations and a context handle.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscCryptoPubCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext)
methods.description: Constructs a new crypto public key object, initializes its members, and returns a handle to it.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoPubRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the specified crypto public key object by freeing its allocated memory.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoPubInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the crypto public key object by setting function pointers and preparing internal state.
